name: copilot-model-restore
description: Configurable reminder to return to your preferred Copilot model.

commands.title: Copilot Model Restore: Return to Preferred Model
Copilot Model Restore: Open Model Picker
Copilot Model Restore: List Available Models

copilotModelRestore.usualModelLabel.description: Name of your preferred Copilot model, for example GPT-5 or Claude Sonnet.

copilotModelRestore.usualModelId.description: ID of your preferred Copilot model, for example deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash.

copilotModelRestore.usualModelVendor.description: Vendor of your preferred Copilot model, for example OpenRouter.

copilotModelRestore.restoreSource.description: Which model to restore: 'default' uses VS Code's chat.defaultModel, 'extension' uses the model configured in this extension's settings, 'both' tries the extension model first and falls back to the default.

copilotModelRestore.showNotificationOnAg.description: Show an informational message when a Copilot agent turn finishes. When false, the model is restored silently.
